title: Quaint Flaky Irish Potato Pie
description: A festive Irish dish featuring sweet chilli sauce and flaky crust, perfect for a special occasion. This pie is bitter, flaky, and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, sweet chilli sauce, and infuse oil, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender to work it into a crumbly mixture.
Gradually add the eggs to the flour mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the potato mixture into the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the pie with a little bit of infuse oil.
Bake the pie for 40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
